smell_validity.evidence: Five scattered copies of one admission decision with genuinely drifting field lists — three regex copies differ and the two file-signature copies disagree, so a record passes one gate and fails another — plus uneven coverage (pretty path bare). Every requirements change becomes a coordinated, unmapable edit; the healthy boundary, validating once where databases load, is unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Changing what a complete record means — a new mandatory field, contributor pre-validation — today requires hunting every copy; drift already makes the same signature pass its scan gate yet fail report assembly, and whether a record reaches the user depends on which stages happened to receive a guard. Consolidation restores a real data-boundary ownership, though within one small package.

development_plausibility.evidence: This is exactly how contributor-fed, unvalidated JSON databases rot: each guard sits where its incident's traceback pointed, in the site's local idiom, checking precisely the fields that stage dereferences, and presence-only semantics exist because shipped records carry null values. The unguarded pretty path reflects a --format-only bug report; no task-shaped regularity is visible.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The contract resolves every trap: per-database rules stated individually, enforcement at the data-access layer, stage-local tests gone, presence-not-truthiness with null file-signature values named, shipped behavior and report shape preserved, the rarity/tag window and matching logic spared, a helper-bag near-miss rejected. Wrong direction, incomplete cleanup, and redesign are decisively excluded while implementation choice stays open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Five different decisions, not repeated edits: pool building must strip its copy while keeping the user-selected rarity/tag window beside it; matching owns a nested Children-structure rule unlike flat presence; the render guards test wrapped match records, not raw entries; scanning dereferences the hex probe; report assembly restores its prior condition for detected records.

localization_burden.evidence: Guards sit across five production modules under partly divergent helper names, so one name search misses copies; each classification combines record flow across components — wrapped match records, detected signatures. Plausible lookalikes must be excluded: the CLI-configured rarity/tag membership and boundaryless selection share expressions with removable guards but are user features.

repair_coordination.evidence: Every guard can only disappear once one boundary rule simultaneously subsumes it: two per-database field sets, presence-not-truthiness semantics, and a nested optional Children check that flat presence cannot express. Adopting any single stage's old field list keeps shipped behavior working locally while silently dropping the guarantees — and drift — that other stages owned.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: No uniform rule survives the two schemas: their required fields are disjoint, so one list breaks one database; truthiness variants silently drop documented null-valued records; neither existing file-signature helper states both stages' needs; consolidation into shared helpers leaves stage-local admission in place, which the task rejects. Well under 20% is fixable without per-schema, per-site decisions.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Two silent paths: incomplete cleanup never changes shipped-data behavior — the guards pass every shipped record — so no behavioral assertion can catch a leftover copy; truthiness-flavored validation silently omits the documented null ISO signature detections from ordinary scans without crashing. The injection touches no tests, and nothing in the material exercises either path.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
